comment: Cross-language golden cases for the classroom50/team/v1 team-description encoding. Both the Go MarshalTeamDescription (cli/gh-teacher/internal/configrepo) and the TS marshalTeamDescription (web/src/util/teamDescription.ts) must produce the `encoded` bytes verbatim for each `input`, so a student reading the description and the two writers never disagree. Go's json.Marshal HTML-escapes < > & by default; the TS side matches. Update every copy in lockstep.
